payload.claim: The frontmatter declares `risk: standard`, but `saffron/cell/session.py` is in `touches` and `.saffron/policy.yaml`'s `elevate_on` lists `saffron/cell/**`, so `saffron/repos/policy.py::effective_risk` will auto-elevate this task to `risk: elevated` at build time regardless of the declared field, which makes the `size` gate blocking rather than advisory (`saffron/gates/suite.py::size_blocks`). This is true but costs nothing here: the measured prototype diff (453 changed tokens outside `tests/**`) sits far under the `bug` ceiling of 1300 either way, and it matches established convention (e.g. `SA-0369`, also touching `saffron/cell/session.py` and also declaring `risk: standard`).
